title: On Montel theorem for mappings with inverse moduli inequalities
summary: This paper is devoted to the study of mappings with finite distortion, in particular, mappings satisfying the inverse Poletskii inequality. We study the problem of equicontinuity of families of such mappings in a given domain. We establish that a family of open discrete mappings with the inverse Poletskii inequality, omitting at least one point, is equicontinuous if the majorant responsible for the distortion of the modulus of families of paths under the mapping is integrable over almost all concentric spheres centered at the given point.
